summary: Batch 1 CR-106 Wave 2 verification (BUG-250/251/253/254/255). 6 of 8 acceptance criteria PASS. TWO CRITICAL FAILURES: BUG-251 WhatsApp button is still visible on aggregator OrderCards (only Cancel was gated with !isAggregator, WhatsApp gate missing), and BUG-254 error toast does NOT render because `sonner` is imported but its `<Toaster>` component is NOT mounted in App.js (only shadcn `Toaster` is mounted).

ui_bugs.issue: BUG-251 partial fix: Cancel(X) button correctly hidden for aggregator (L966 `!isAggregator && isOrderCancelAllowed`), but WhatsApp payment button (L979) is only gated by `showWhatsAppPayment` — missing the `!isAggregator` gate. Verified: aggregator OrderCards 40474, 40475, 40476, 40477 all have `data-testid="whatsapp-payment-btn-{orderId}"` present in DOM.

BUG-254 error toast fix is BROKEN. DashboardPage imports `{ toast } from 'sonner'` and calls `toast.error('Failed to mark ready — please retry')` at L1394 (also L1362, L1378, L1410). But App.js only mounts shadcn `<Toaster />` from `./components/ui/toaster` — the `sonner` `<Toaster>` is never mounted, so sonner toasts have no host and DO NOT render. Verified via DOM: no `[data-sonner-toaster]` element exists, no toast appears after Ready click even though POST /api/v1/urbanpiper/orders-status-update returns 500 and console logs `[Dashboard] Aggregator ready failed: AxiosError`.

verification_details.BUG-250_polling_persistence: PASS — Aggregator cards 40474/75/76/77 (S badge, ₹179.55) STILL present in Delivery channel after 80s wait. POLL_INTERVAL_MS=60s so at least one full cycle completed.
verification_details.BUG-250_dispatched_label: PASS — Card 40477 (f_order_status=5) shows 'Dispatch...' (truncated 'Dispatched') as status label in TableCard, NOT 'Served'. Preparing cards (40474/75/76) show 'Preparing'.
verification_details.BUG-251_cancel_hidden: PASS — No cancel-order-btn-{40474..40477} testids on any aggregator OrderCard in Order View.
verification_details.BUG-251_whatsapp_hidden: FAIL — whatsapp-payment-btn-{40474..40477} testids present on all 4 aggregator OrderCards. Regression: regular delivery OrderCard 892353 (#002286 Del ₹105) still has cancel + whatsapp as expected.
verification_details.BUG-253_platform_filter: PASS — Dropdown testid `dashboard-platform-filter-wrapper` opens 4 options with testids `dashboard-platform-filter-option-{all,pos,web,aggregator}` (labels: Platform: All / POS / Web / Scan / Aggregator). Selecting 'Aggregator' → only 4 S-badge cards visible (Delivery channel count = 4). Selecting 'POS' → 0 aggregator badges visible, only Del/mayur/parth/saurav regular cards.
verification_details.BUG-254_error_toast: FAIL — 500 response confirmed on POST /api/v1/urbanpiper/orders-status-update after Ready click. Console shows `[Dashboard] Aggregator ready failed: AxiosError`. But NO toast renders (`hasSonnerToaster=false`, `sonnerCount=0`, no visible red toast). Root cause: sonner `<Toaster>` component not mounted in App.js — only shadcn Toaster is mounted, but code calls sonner's toast.error.
verification_details.BUG-255_item_dots: PASS (code-verified) — OrderCard.jsx L623 `const actionConfig = isAggregator ? null : getItemActionConfig(item);` and L401 `handleItemAction` early-returns for aggregator. Aggregator OrderCards render items without status toggle dots. Note: item dots would already be hidden for delivery/takeaway via `isItemActionable`, so this fix is defensive but code-correct.
verification_details.compilation: PASS — Frontend compiled cleanly, dashboard rendered without errors (no webpack errors in console).
verification_details.regular_orders_regression: PASS — Regular delivery OrderCard 892353 (#002286 Del ₹105 priti) retains cancel-order-btn-892353, whatsapp-payment-btn-892353, assign-rider-btn-892353. Regular saurav (#002280) shows 'Rider is on the way'. TableCard 'Del ₹105' has Assign button. No regressions detected.

action_items: FIX BUG-251 WhatsApp: In /app/frontend/src/components/cards/OrderCard.jsx L979, change `{showWhatsAppPayment && (` to `{!isAggregator && showWhatsAppPayment && (` so the WhatsApp button is also hidden for aggregator orders (matching the intent stated in the review request `!isAggregator on ... WhatsApp L979`).

FIX BUG-254 Toast: The toast library is mismatched. Either (a) mount sonner's Toaster in /app/frontend/src/App.js by importing `{ Toaster as SonnerToaster } from 'sonner'` (or the wrapper at src/components/ui/sonner.jsx which exports `Toaster`) and rendering `<SonnerToaster />` next to the existing `<Toaster />`, OR (b) change the imports in DashboardPage.jsx L35 from `sonner` to the project's shadcn `use-toast` hook and rewrite `toast.error(...)` calls accordingly. Currently sonner toasts have no host and are silently dropped.
critical_code_review_comments: DashboardPage.jsx is 2145 lines — still exceeds the 700 LOC guideline; consider splitting adaptOrder helpers into a separate module.
OrderCard.jsx L979 WhatsApp gate is inconsistent with L966 Cancel gate — both should share the same `!isAggregator` guard for symmetry with BUG-251 spec.
Toast library confusion: App uses shadcn Toaster in App.js but DashboardPage.jsx imports sonner. Pick ONE toast system project-wide and remove the other to prevent silent failures like BUG-254.
useOrderPollingReconciliation isAggregator skip and mergeRunningOrders preservation (BUG-250) are working correctly — no code review concerns there.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (6/8 bugs verified fixed; BUG-251 partial, BUG-254 broken)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing preprod aggregator orders 40474-40477 (Swiggy, restaurant 478).
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent applies the two fixes: (1) add `!isAggregator &&` to OrderCard.jsx L979 WhatsApp gate; (2) mount sonner's Toaster in App.js. Then re-verify: switch to Order View + Aggregator filter, confirm whatsapp-payment-btn-{40474..40477} testids are absent. For BUG-254, click agg-ready-btn-delivery-40474 (or any Preparing aggregator ready button) and wait ~3s — a red sonner toast with text 'Failed to mark ready — please retry' should appear (server returns 500 for stale UrbanPiper IDs). Use `[data-sonner-toast]` or `[data-sonner-toaster]` selectors to detect it.

rca of the issue.BUG-251_whatsapp: The review request stated `!isAggregator on Cancel L966, WhatsApp L979` but only L966 was patched. L979 kept its original `showWhatsAppPayment` gate. Missing single-token edit.
rca of the issue.BUG-254_toast: Two different toast systems coexist in the codebase: shadcn `./components/ui/toaster` (mounted in App.js L191) and sonner (wrapper at ./components/ui/sonner.jsx). BUG-254 fix imported sonner's `toast` in DashboardPage.jsx L35 but neither the sonner wrapper's `<Toaster>` nor sonner's native `<Toaster>` is rendered anywhere. Result: toast.error() enqueues to a non-existent host and is silently dropped.
